name: PakBusiness Pro
description: Multi-tenant offline business management app with Wholesale & Distribution (Parties, Udhaar/Khata ledger, bulk orders, payment vouchers), Laundry & Dry Cleaners (customer records, order taking for Shirt/Pants/Bedsheet, order tracking Washing->Ironing->Ready->Delivered), Auto Workshop, Electronics, Bakery, Tailor, Hotel, Salon, Real Estate, School, Pharmacy, Clinic, Restaurant POS, and multi-currency support.
